summary: The Archipiélago de San Andrés, Providencia y Santa Catalina is a department of Colombia and stands under the national framework; the source inventory contains no incident, law, enforcement or institutional finding specific to the archipelago, so no region-specific signal was identified and the national assessment applies.
tangentialFactors: The two sources in the inventory document lethal anti-trans violence in other departments of Colombia, and neither records an incident, a law or an enforcement finding for the archipelago. No source addresses whether conditions in the archipelago differ from the pattern documented elsewhere in the country.
localsOnly: No resident-facing finding specific to the archipelago appears in the source inventory. Residents of the department fall under the same national legal framework as Colombians elsewhere, and no source records how that framework operates in the department's own institutions.
outOfScopeNotes:
The absence of an archipelago-level finding is an absence of sourcing, not a documented absence of risk. Neither source in the inventory contains departmental crime statistics, local enforcement or prosecution records, incidents on the islands, or any account of how national provisions are applied by institutions in the department. Both sources date from 2024 and 2025 and neither addresses the archipelago.

The inventory carries no per-capita or population denominator for any jurisdiction, so no comparison between the archipelago and other departments can be drawn from it.
